column1: # V2 ledger (D14): one row per claim checked, or per refutation case. Read by tools/verify/v2_metric.py (the format of tests/v1/ledger.tsv; merged may list several hashes, comma-separated).
# verdict: confirmed | refuted | partial | fixed | unverified
#   refuted / partial = an open refutation (the test still fails on the owner's newest head)
#   fixed             = the owner's fix was re-verified with the same test (closed)
# merged: the integration commit that carries the claim, or - when it is not merged
# fix: the commit that fixed a refutation (re-verified), or -
